claims: São Paulo defeated Chapecoense 2-0 on March 12, 2026.
São Paulo's match against Chapecoense on March 12, 2026 was a Brasileirão Serie A match.
São Paulo's match against Chapecoense on March 12, 2026 took place at Estádio do Canindé, São Paulo.
Luciano scored a goal at 46' in São Paulo's match against Chapecoense on March 12, 2026.
Jonathan Calleri scored a goal at 60' in São Paulo's match against Chapecoense on March 12, 2026.
The goals by Luciano and Jonathan Calleri were scored in the second half.
São Paulo's 2-0 win over Chapecoense placed São Paulo at the top of the table with 13 points.
São Paulo's match against Chapecoense on March 12, 2026 marked Roger Machado's debut as São Paulo coach.
São Paulo's match against Chapecoense on March 12, 2026 was part of the 5th round of the 2026 Brasileirão Betano.
São Paulo moved to 1st/2nd place after their match against Chapecoense.
Chapecoense dropped to 12th place after their match against São Paulo.
The result left Chapecoense 8 points behind the leaders.
